claim.quote: We present a determination of the Cabibbo-Kobayashi-Maskawa matrix element |Vcb | from the decay B → Dℓνℓ using a 365 fb−1 e+ e− → Υ(4S) → B B̄ data sample recorded by the Belle II experiment at the SuperKEKB collider.

key_value_text.note: |Vcb| is a dimensionless CKM matrix element; recorded as key_value_text (not a Quantity) since the ontology has no dedicated dimensionless-ratio unit, mirroring the existing convention in result:nova-oscillation-parameters-2022.

name: Determination of |Vcb| using B→Dℓνℓ Decays at Belle II

summary.plain: Belle II measured how often a B meson (a particle containing a bottom quark) decays into a D meson plus a lepton and neutrino, and used that to pin down |Vcb|, a fundamental number that sets how strongly bottom and charm quarks convert into each other.
summary.technical: Inclusive-tag determination of |Vcb| from B0->D-(->K+pi-pi-) l+ nu_l and B+->D0bar(->K+pi-) l+ nu_l decays in 365 fb^-1 of Belle II Upsilon(4S) data, using the recoil variable w=v_B.v_D and lattice-QCD form-factor averages. Reports B(B0->D- l+ nu_l) = (2.06 +/- 0.05stat +/- 0.10sys)%, B(B+->D0bar l+ nu_l) = (2.31 +/- 0.04stat +/- 0.09sys)%, a lepton-flavor-universality ratio B(B->D e nu_e)/B(B->D mu nu_mu) = 1.020 +/- 0.020stat +/- 0.022sys, and |Vcb| = (39.2 +/- 0.4stat +/- 0.6sys +/- 0.5th)x10^-3.

title: Determination of |Vcb| using B→Dℓνℓ Decays at Belle II
why_it_matters: |Vcb| is one of the least precisely known entries of the CKM quark-mixing matrix and a long-standing input to tests of the Standard Model's flavor sector; Belle II's large, clean e+e- data set gives an independent determination from the exclusive B->D l nu channel.
